criteria.evidence:
Five named dimensions: live BOLA/IDOR, valid mutating body, same-tenant control, abuse protection, privacy. The ticket's own Status concedes 'the individual live-BOLA, mutating-body and privacy criteria were not re-audited item by item - only observed green as a whole.' A criterion that asks for an audited live surface is not closed by observing an aggregate green - and the aggregate is not green.

REFUTED SUB-CLAIM (the ticket's recorded completion evidence is FALSE at head). The ticket records '`test/security` went 8 failed / 592 passed / 600 total -> 0 failed / 604 passed / 604 total (44 suites)'. I RAN IT MYSELF at e1fd1d475:
  `node --max-old-space-size=4096 ./node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --testPathPattern="test/security/" --maxWorkers=2 --silent --ci`
  -> Test Suites: 1 failed, 43 passed, 44 total
  -> Tests:       2 failed, 602 passed, 604 total
Both failures are in test/security/bola/bola-body-id-binding.spec.ts:
  :144 `expect(counts.queryFields).toBe(239)` -> received 243. Four new id-shaped query fields entered the contract and have never been swept for body-id binding.
  :157 the 'handler-not-found' set gained 'UsersController_listUsersV2_v2'; the test's own title is 'resolves a handler for all but a named few - an unresolved handler is a blind spot, not a pass'.
So the pin is doing its job and nobody moved it. The specific defect the previous audit found (the 3642-vs-3644 operations pin) WAS fixed - :138 now reads toBe(3648) and openapi.json holds 3648 operations across 2703 paths - but the suite went red again on two other pins in the same file.

PER DIMENSION AT HEAD:
* LIVE BOLA/IDOR - NOT MEASURED at head by anyone. The classifier is genuinely well built (test/security/bola/live/probe-plan.ts: a 403 scores EXISTENCE-ORACLE not a pass; an ungraded same-tenant control is UNPROBEABLE; a third absent-id request separates a real leak from a route that never resolves; MIN_SCORED fails a collapsed run). But the last real run is v1 15h's bola-head-full.json - 1,929 routes, PASS 681 / NO-404 29 / SERVER-ERROR 6 / LEAK 4 / UNPROBEABLE 1,208, i.e. 35.3% probed-and-correct and 62.6% never asked - and that artifact exists in NEITHER repository, so the release's single largest security claim cannot be re-derived. Re-running it needs a seeded two-tenant database and ~1h exclusive wall clock.
* VALID MUTATING BODY - MET. live/body-synthesis.ts derives a minimal valid body and required query params per route from openapi.json, every Outcome stamps bodySource, and the harness asserts the 'empty body 400 -> derived body 2xx' property rather than assuming it.
* SAME-TENANT CONTROL - the RULE is enforced and unit-tested; as a FACT only 721 of 1,929 object-addressable routes (37.4%) had a demonstrated working control at the last measurement, and that measurement is stale.
* ABUSE PROTECTION - NOT MET, still, at head, verified by me:
  - src/common/ratelimit/rate-limit.guard.ts:8-13 `extractClientIp` takes `raw?.split(",")[0]?.trim() || req.ip` - the LEFTMOST X-Forwarded-For hop, the one a client supplies - and the identical helper is duplicated at src/common/http/client-ip.ts:5-10. `grep -rn 'trust proxy' src/ --include='*.ts'`, `grep -rn 'trustProxy' src/ --include='*.ts'` and a scan of main.ts for the adapter's proxy config ALL return ZERO hits. The prior audit measured the consequence end-to-end against the real guard: fixed header 150 requests -> 120 blocked with 429; rotating first hop 150 requests -> 0 blocked. Every unauthenticated rate limit is bypassable.
  - src/common/ratelimit/rate-limit-coverage.spec.ts:117-127 still PINS four unauthenticated writes with no limiter of any kind at head: POST /internal/audit (the fourth INTERNAL_API_SECRET route), POST /careers/apply (the tier 'public:job-apply' 3/hour is declared and referenced by no route), POST /csat/:surveyId/responses, POST /crm/mailboxes/push. The spec records them rather than failing.
  - src/modules/public/public.controller.ts:238-247 - POST /public/intake/:projectId is still addressed by a sequential integer (`projectIdParams = z.object({ projectId: z.coerce.number().int().positive() })`, :74) with no token, while every sibling public form on the same controller (forms/:token, lead-form/:token, nps/:token, vendor-portal/:token, external-referral/:token) uses an unguessable token. It carries @UseRateLimit('public:intake'), which the X-Forwarded-For defect above removes.
* PRIVACY - MIXED, and the P0 IS FIXED. The prior audit's F1 (GDPR erasure destroying a multi-org user's global identity because the surviving-membership guard was RLS-blind) is REPAIRED at head: src/modules/gdpr/gdpr-subject-erasure-identity.ts:189-193 now reads `return runOutsideTenantContext(() => withIdentity(db, subjectUserId, async (tx) => ...))`, with a 35-line comment recording the measured 0-rows-vs-1-row proof and why a savepoint would be wrong. F8 (the bite proof green over that defect) follows: gdpr-subject-erasure.spec.ts:32/37 now mocks withIdentity, so the fixture matches the real path. STILL OPEN on this dimension: retention is proven only over 14 of 944 tables (check:retention-coverage's population is 'tables over 1 MB on the connected database'), and test/security/public-token-controls.spec.ts is unchanged - 150 lines, 16 readFileSync/toMatch assertions, self-described 'Static verification ... reads source files as strings', so the public/share-token surface (one of the six PRD-C081 enumerates) is claimed by a suite that cannot fail on a behavioural regression.
* SECRET HANDLING - green and verified: the sql.raw hardening the ticket claims IS at head (src/common/db/bulk-update.ts scopeFor/assertPostgresType/assertKnownColumn validate every identifier and cast name against the target table's own Drizzle columns); check:hardcoded-secrets exit 0 over 16,099 files; check:log-secrets exit 0 over 3,658 files.

RESPONSE-SHAPE TRUST, if C003's surface includes it: 27 of 3,648 backend operations declare a 2xx content schema (0.74%, from check:openapi-coverage at head, which is exit 1), and frontend check:response-contracts reports 'Carrying a contract: 86 (3.2%)' of 2,666 fetch-seam calls with its own note 'NOTE: 97.8% of the seam is still an unchecked cast. This gate freezes that debt; it does not retire it.'
criteria.blocker: test/security is RED at head (I ran it: 1 suite / 2 tests failed, 602/604), which falsifies the ticket's recorded '0 failed / 604 passed'. Abuse protection is unmet in code: leftmost-hop X-Forwarded-For in rate-limit.guard.ts:8-13 and client-ip.ts:5-10 with no `trust proxy` anywhere in src/, plus four pinned unauthenticated writes with no limiter and an integer-addressed unauthenticated cross-tenant write at public.controller.ts:238. The live BOLA/IDOR surface has not been measured at head and its last artifact (bola-head-full.json) exists in neither repository, so 'live BOLA/IDOR' cannot be evidenced at all. Closing needs: the two bola-body-id-binding pins re-derived, `trust proxy` set with the header read deleted from both helpers, the four writes limited, and a seeded re-run of bola-live-cross-tenant on a two-tenant database.
criteria.clauses_failing: 'live BOLA/IDOR' (not measured at head; the last artifact is absent from both repos); 'abuse protection' (X-Forwarded-For rotation defeats every unauthenticated limit; 4 unlimited public writes; integer-addressed public intake); 'privacy' partially (retention proven over 14 of 944 tables; the public/share-token suite is 100% source-string matching). HOLDING: 'valid mutating body'; the same-tenant-control RULE (though only 37.4% of the surface has a demonstrated control as a fact); secret handling and the sql.raw hardening; the P0 GDPR RLS-blind erasure guard, which is FIXED at head.
